BSE_AP.jurisdiction: Secondary Education (Class 9 Academic Support & Class 10 Secondary School Certificate / SSC Examination)

BIEAP.name: Board of Intermediate Education, Andhra Pradesh (BIEAP)
BIEAP.headquarters: Eswar Elite, Tadepalli, Guntur - 522501, Andhra Pradesh
BIEAP.jurisdiction: Higher Secondary / Intermediate Education (Class 11 Inter 1st Year & Class 12 Inter 2nd Year)

class_9.examination_status: Annual School-Level Summative Assessment (SA-2) & CCE Framework
class_9.service_type: Academic Foundation, School-Based Evaluation, Child Info Enrolment for SSC

progression_to_class_10.rule: Progression to Class 10 requires passing Class 9 Summative Assessment (SA-2) under SCERT AP Continuous and Comprehensive Evaluation guidelines, maintaining minimum 75% attendance, and valid student Aadhaar/Child Info registration.

class_10.service_type: Public Secondary Board Examination, 7-Paper Pattern Verification, Practice & Model Papers

paper_pattern_structure.pattern_description: Seven-Paper Examination Pattern: First Language (1 paper, 100 marks), Second Language (1 paper, 100 marks), Third Language English (1 paper, 100 marks), Mathematics (1 paper, 100 marks), General Science (Physical Science 50 marks on Day 1 + Biological Science 50 marks on Day 2 = 100 marks total), Social Studies (1 paper, 100 marks).
paper_pattern_structure.exam_duration: 3 hours 15 minutes per 100-mark paper (including 15 minutes reading time); Physical Science and Biological Science are 2 hours each.

first_languages_official: Composite Courses: Telugu + Sanskrit, Urdu + Persian/Arabic

core_non_language_subjects.name: General Science (సాధారణ శాస్త్రం - Physical Science & Biological Science)

class_11.service_type: BIEAP Administered Inter 1st Year Examination, Group Foundation, Continuous Practical Log

progression_to_class_12.rule: Progression to Intermediate Second Year requires appearing in and qualifying Inter 1st Year public examinations, maintaining minimum 75% attendance, and clearing non-core qualifying papers (Ethics and Human Values, Environmental Education).

class_12.examination_name: Intermediate Public Examination (IPE) / Inter Second Year Examination
class_12.service_type: Public Higher Secondary Board Examination, Major Stream Groups (MPC, BiPC, CEC, MEC, HEC, Vocational)

vocational.description: General Foundation Course, English, Vocational Theory I, II, III & Practical Practicum.

class_12.scheme_of_examination: Combined 1st & 2nd Year Cumulative Total: 1000 Marks. Lab subjects feature 60 Marks Theory + 30 Marks Practical per year. Mathematics features 75 Marks Theory per paper. Commerce/Arts feature 100 Marks Theory per paper.

passing_criteria.division_system: Grade A / First Division (>= 60%), Grade B / Second Division (50% to < 60%), Grade C / Third Division (35% to < 50%), Fail (< 35%).
